caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object composed of three main parts: a cylindrical container with a handle, a tall vertical cylinder attached to its side, and a slightly concave round tray or plate as the base. The cylindrical container has a lid with a horizontal handlebar on top, while the handle on its side is curved and robust. The tall cylinder has a slightly wider top, with what appears to be a wick or some fibrous material protruding from its opening. The entire composition sits on a round tray with a lip. The objects are rendered in shades of bluish-gray and dark metallic hues, showing subtle shading and variations in tone to suggest a metallic and worn texture. The background is a plain off-white or beige, providing contrast to the darker objects. Near the bottom right of the tray, the name "WAYNE WHITE" is printed in small, uppercase text.
title: Lard Lamp
